review_evidence: README identifies the project as a Lean 4 implementation of the IPLD format and describes running its LSpec tests.
A complete scan of 14 Lean files found 172 declaration-style items and no theorem/lemma/axiom/example declarations.

The source consists of IPLD codecs/data structures plus executable test-case tables for DAG-CBOR, multihash, unsigned varints and multibase; it does not encode an independent declarative IPLD specification or prove codec/conformance properties.

source_action.content_invariant: The source implements IPLD codecs and executable test fixtures but has no proposition declarations or independent formal format semantics/correctness development. Retirement is therefore content-lossless for formal prior-art search.
